cases.title: exact tied best bases: the tie set holds every base at the minimum and any of them is a strict hit
unique best base: a near miss is an epsilon hit but not a strict hit
delta worse than standalone: finite O_delta, O = S, not useful, SavingsCapture N/A
empty C_t for a near target: O_delta = +inf, empty argmin, O = S, recalls N/A
all codec failures for a target: bounded oracle, O = S, recalls N/A, G1 blocked
one timeout: the timed-out base costs +inf, choosing it is a miss with full regret
missing expected pair: INCOMPLETE, no oracle values and no metrics are released
duplicate pair row, even byte-identical: INVALID, never deduplicated
decode mismatch: INVALID run, not a +inf cost
zero-byte target: raw frame (2 B) wins; delta cannot beat it
tiny target: base reference alone exceeds the raw frame
standalone raw wins over compressed; base reference bytes change the regret
standalone compressed wins: patch payload below S but total cost above S
zero SavingsCapture denominator: no useful target in the population gives N/A, not 1
epsilon boundary exactly at the 64 B floor counts as a hit (<=)
epsilon just outside the floor; above the floor the epsilon share decides (1% miss, 2% hit)
reordered pair rows give the identical canonical result (same as K01, digests included)
foreign base row outside the candidate lock: INVALID
wrong codec options hash on one row: INVALID
evaluator SHA changes, measurement rows unchanged: same measurement identity and metrics, a new evaluation record; no verdict transfers between evaluator identities
ok row whose decoded SHA-256 differs from the target: INVALID
retrieval returns a base outside C_t: retrieval INVALID, oracle unaffected, no metrics
retrieval with a repeated base and more than K entries: retrieval INVALID
delta_total_bytes inconsistent with payload + wrapper + base reference: INVALID
identity-only target: standalone measured, excluded from every near population
missing retrieval row for a near target: retrieval INVALID, never filled with the oracle base
standalone compressor timeout: S falls back to the raw frame, bounded run
empty retrieval list on a useful target: A = S, full regret, call reduction N/A
encode_calls below the number of retrieved bases: retrieval INVALID
sealed evaluation split: completeness and correctness counted, costs withheld, metrics only over unsealed targets
cost rows of a sealed split published unsealed: INVALID (leakage)
decoder exits non-zero on a patch the encoder produced: decode_mismatch, INVALID, not +inf
materialized base bytes do not hash to the locked object ID: INVALID
runner abort leaves a not_run row: the pair counts as missing, INCOMPLETE
O_delta equal to S: not useful (strict <), O = S
normalized regret uses max(O, 64 B) when O is below 64 B
sealed ok row whose decoded SHA-256 differs from the target: INVALID even without published costs

expansion: contract.md section 10: labels map to IDs Hc(["delsk.oracle.kat.v1","occurrence"|"object",label]); omitted fields take the frame-v1 values; "set" overrides full-row fields after expansion; rationals are reduced "p/q" strings; null O_delta is +inf

g1_cases.title: two COMPLETE runs, distinct run IDs, equal digests, conformance and bundle verified
two attempts of the same run ID are not independent
repeat with different cost projection: nondeterministic measurement
an INVALID attempt of the identity cannot be outvoted by later good runs
a bounded attempt (codec failure) blocks G1
a run without codec conformance does not count as a repeat
